title: Same-volume VZ controller exclusivity and cold recovery authority source fences

execution.environment: Isolated no-NIC Linux ARM64 VZ, private persistent volume and controlled local review services

checks.detail: Two same-volume contenders exited before boot while the original owned one active lease.
Same retired VM and copied-stop-ACK different-volume attempts had no issued grant.
Two matching payloads sourced from restored state were rejected before any service listened or mutated old state.
Trusted RO grant released the old lease; identical original retry produced verified MP3 and PCM.
Cross-host lock, resident Linux route, and production guest.

notes: Preexisting signed runner and controller were reused. Burner was not submitted.
